newsitem.title: ITALY: BASKETBALL-BROKEN GLASS HOLDS UP PLAY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BROKEN GLASS HOLDS UP PLAY.

text.p: Play was held up for 20 minutes at European basketball's Final Four third place play-off on Thursday after the glass backboard shattered just 90 seconds into the match.

The contest between Villeurbanne of France and Slovenian champions Ljubljana was interrupted when Ljubljana's Marko Milic broke clear to land a spectacular slam-dunk, only for the hoop to whip back and shatter the toughened glass.
Workmen struggled to replace the fitting and install a replacement before play eventually resumed with Ljubljana leading 7-3.
They went on to win the game 86-79, Milic topscoring with 17 points.
The final between Olympiakos and Barcelona was being played later on Thursday.
